# EOS Vision provenance Q01 cases

These frozen cases are **target design, not runtime evidence**. `cases.json` fixes positive and negative owner expectations for the first implementation tests. Run `python3 tests/fixtures/q01_vision_provenance/check_cases.py` to validate case structure. The selected Q01 replay must later exercise the live route, identity, cap and queue counters; this fixture alone does not close Q01.
